name: Knights of the Black Rose
oracle_text:
When this creature enters, you become the monarch.
Whenever an opponent becomes the monarch, if you were the monarch as the turn began, that player loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
blocked_sentences: Whenever an opponent becomes the monarch, if you were the monarch as the turn began, that player loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.

needs.what: a condition that asks whether a given player was the monarch at the moment the current turn began (a per-turn snapshot of the monarch recorded at the start of the turn), usable as an intervening-if on a becomes_monarch trigger
needs.why_existing_wont_do: condition_keys has is_monarch and no_monarch, which read the monarch now; at resolution of a becomes_monarch trigger the opponent is already the monarch, so is_monarch cannot tell whether you held it when the turn began. has_turn_flag reads a flag on the source object, not who was monarch, and no value_key records the turn-start monarch
